_note: Mission types (Logan, 2026-09-27/28). summary: a concise rundown (Logan, 2026-10-16), shown after the mission's name. map_layout: MapGenerator's layout (2: walkers, Logan 2026-10-16; a save from before carries its mission without it, so its map stays layout 1). Numbers marked Proposed are Claude's starting values for tuning. rows = stops before the boss. Regular fights come from the location's encounter pools: the first weak_fights from `weak`, then `strong` (max_enemies caps a fight's size). Longer runs (Logan, 2026-09-30): Assault and Rescue 12 rows, Deep Recon 16, a refit after every 3rd row, and a repair bay every path goes through right before the boss (repair_before_boss). max_shops (Logan, 2026-09-30): at most that many autonomous bays on a map (at least one is always there); shops are a detour you choose, Slay-the-Spire style. An event stop also turns out to be a bay 10% of the time (balance.json map.event_shop_chance).

assault.name: Assault
assault.summary: Straight push to the target. Ends in a boss.

deep_recon.name: Deep Recon
deep_recon.summary: Longer. Lighter enemies, tougher elites. No boss. Disables the boss for one turn at the next location.

rescue.name: Rescue
rescue.summary: In and out fast. Alert rises every turn you fight, and fights get harder with it. Ends in a boss.

training.name: Simulated Mission
training.summary: Simulator. Two short fights vs a Scrap Warden, a salvage and a refit. Doesn't count toward your record.
training.location_description: The Shipyard, as the simulator remembers it: the cranes and dry docks are holograms, the enemy is a recording, and nothing you lose here is lost for real.
